title: Controllable synthesis of Ru nanocrystallites on graphene substrate as a catalyst for ammonia synthesis
extraction_notes: The supplied Supporting Information contains only figure captions and figures for Ru precursor/polyol solution time courses and UV-Vis absorption spectra (SI Fig. s1 and SI Fig. s2). No experimental ammonia synthesis catalyst-performance data (rate, outlet NH3, TOF, or reaction-condition performance entries) are reported in the SI.
